prompt_for_image_ai:
Create ONE flat vector landing sticker.

SIZE LOCK — IDENTICAL ON EVERY RIASEC LETTER (R, I, A, S, E, C):
- Canvas: exactly 1024px wide × 1024px tall. Fill entire canvas with solid paper #FDFCF8. No transparency. No black background.
- Sticker frame: exactly 780px OUTER WIDTH × 640px OUTER HEIGHT. Not wider. Not narrower. Not taller. Not shorter.
- Aspect ratio of the frame is fixed at 780:640. Letter I must use this exact same height and width as letters R, S, and C.
- Corner radius ~48px. Border stroke ~10px lavender #B39DDB.
- Frame centered: left margin 122px, right margin 122px, top margin 192px, bottom margin 192px.
- Interior fill #FDFCF8.

HEIGHT LOCK: the frame outer height is 640px. Character head sits near the top inner border (~24px padding). Character waist and props are flush to and cropped by the INNER bottom border. Character fills the full interior height — no floating, no short figure with empty paper above and below.

LARGE LETTER LOCK (match gold R, S, C): left half, bold rounded SANS-SERIF block capital I — simple block I with the SAME rounded sans recipe as R/S/C. Fill #6E4FB8. Thin white inner offset stroke. Thick dark outer outline #2D2D2D. Letter height about 420px, vertically centered. CRITICAL: NOT a serif I, NOT a slab-serif I, NOT a Roman/Times I.

CORNER BADGE: ~56px circle bottom-right inside frame, small capital I, purple fill, same sans style.

CHARACTER: young Pathfinder, light peach skin, dark brown low ponytail, thin 2px outline #2D2D2D, flat fills, minimal black dot eyes. Faces inward-left toward I. White blouse, deep purple cardigan #6E4FB8. Right hand: magnifying glass near face. Left hand: closed notebook at torso. Waist flush to bottom border.

Style: KursoKo questionnaire unDraw flat vector. Minimal props.
